name: paper-reading-workbench
description: Read one academic paper as a traceable, sequential, question-driven Obsidian workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Deep paper reading into a bilingual Obsidian workspace.
interface.longDescription: Preserve and segment a paper, read it chunk by chunk through a continuous Reader and Answerer loop, and publish a complete bilingual annotated edition with traceable questions, evidence, figures, tables, formulas, and resumable state.
interface.defaultPrompt: Read this paper deeply and create a complete bilingual Obsidian workspace in the requested folder.
